description: Use when an agent needs text sorted into its own categories. Returns a score per label that sums to 1 and the best label, for up to 4,000 characters and 2 to 20 labels. Labels are names, never instructions. Cached 24 hours. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

labels.description: 2 to 20 labels, comma separated, e.g. billing,bug,feature

text.description: the text to classify, up to 4,000 characters

name: get_classify

data.description: the get_classify payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_classify

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Text classification
